sources.quote: Service and aftermarket parts are not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)

findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 from Alluminio B (AP-0311) covers TO1 and STL series supply. The approved source list excludes service and aftermarket parts, and no other controlled record covers BR-220 as a service part. So the absence of an approval cannot be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm whether Alluminio B is released for BR-220 service parts, and for which receiving plant.

BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: The request uses Alluminio B billet already in stock. No document gives the grade, lot, certificate or test result for that stock. Drawing Rev C and the BOM need EN AW-6082-T6, and AP-0311 approves that grade. A person must supply the certificate for the stock lot to show it is 6082-T6.
